title: Climate Change Talks Move Beyond Deadline
main_content:
Leaders in Paris negotiating a climate change agreement missed their deadline on Friday.

Representatives from 195 countries have spent two weeks in Paris at the United Nations climate talks, known as COP21.

French Foreign Minister Laurent Fabius extended the deadline until Saturday when the deadline could not be met.

U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry said a lot of progress has been made, but he said, some “very difficult” issues must be resolved.

He met with French Foreign Minister Laurent Fabius on Friday.

The biggest sticking points are the financial aid and the long-term goal. First, how much financial aid will the rich nations give the poorer nations to help them? Second, what will the final long-term goal say?

This conference was working toward capping a rise in global temperatures this century.

Nations have met since 1992 to discuss ways to stop global warming.
